title: Chapter 928
paragraphs: Chapter 928
Episode 231. Resolution (1)
Bascara ignored even the divine right of Solderet, immunity to curses. Jin shuddered at the sensation of rapidly draining strength in his left arm.
It was already a weakened area where his fist had shattered. With aging added to it, it seemed he wouldn't be able to use his left arm at all.
Forced aging was a curse that could be realized when the god of time, Alta, directly manifested.
This meant that Phaelito had a divine right equivalent to Alta's manifested state, even with regards to the domain of time.
'Even if Phaelito is a transcendent being, he cannot be equal to Lord Alta in terms of the power of time. This curse is likely the power of his sword...'
-[... The sword Bascara he uses has the power to block divine rights.]
Orgal described Bascara that way to Jin just after he was defeated by Phaelito, but in reality, Bascara was not just a sword with the ability to seal divine rights.
It also had the ability to use the divine rights that it had perfectly sealed even once.
"There was a demon god named Bisaro. He was a being who aged the demons who desired death, and he too was sealed in this sword for daring to oppose Lord Zito."
Phaelito met Jin's gaze.
"You and your god's power will also be sealed in Bascara today, so it's better to get used to the sensation of aging. The resentment of Bisaro contained in the sword seems to treat you quite warmly."

Phaelito, as it were, was a warrior who had reached the transcendent state and had freely mastered the divine rights of numerous gods and transcendent beings that had been sealed in Bascara during the process.
The ruler of the demon world.
That was why there was no disagreement about his authority.
"Kahak!"
Dante blocked Phaelito's blow and stumbled back.
It was an attack that he could have narrowly dodged under normal circumstances, but due to his aged right leg, he had no choice but to block.
His reaction had noticeably slowed. Thanks to the true energy received from Ron, Dante had become one of the strongest, but he couldn't do anything about the aging.
His movements were frustrating as if shackled, and his ankle bones rattled each time he stamped on the ground.
'If it were an ordinary curse, I could reverse it...'
Normally, a curse could be exterminated by killing the caster or using a dispel magic. There was also a way to strike the object that manifested the curse.
"But since the physical manifestation has already progressed this much, I guess I'll have to give up on my arm."
Even if they lose an arm, or a leg, as long as they can fight, it's okay. As long as they can fight without falling midway until their entire bodies crumble away, they were determined.

Phaelito was deliberately attacking at a speed where Dante could not evade, only block. So that Jin would feel helpless even as he watched his friend dying by his side, and fall into self-loathing as his extended sword swings at nothing.
However, Dante didn't want Jin to come to his rescue. Since entering the battle that day, he hadn't thought for a moment that he would need to be saved.
It had always been this way.
Since the day Jin saved him in Sword Emperor City. No, since they first met at the Cosmos Championship and became friends.
Dante always harbored the expectation that he might die in battle with Jin someday. After all, Jin was also walking a path where he had to break through dangerous battles.

"You're quite the coward, Phaelito! Did you think that if you did this, Jin would go crazy trying to save me? That he would charge in recklessly shouting my name? Not a chance! We have both resolved ourselves to death. Even if we die here together, there will not be a case where only one of us survives."
Zuaaaa-!
Dante's dragon-armored sword emitted an even stronger light. Phaelito created some distance and shot sword energy.

"We are not afraid to die together. So if you really want to see Jin suffer, you have to kill me, the Sword Emperor of the Empire, first. No matter how strong you are, if you continue to toy with us like this, you will not be able to avoid anger. You should know this best yourself."
The words Dante said were not just bluffs.

While Dante was under pressure, Jin was calmly targeting Phaelito's rear. Phaelito was unable to perfectly block because he was 'controlling his strength', and occasionally, Bradamante managed to get a hit in somewhere on his body.
Of course, all were only minor injuries that could not affect the general trend.
However, in a fight at this level, every single injury could become a fatal blow, just like a single piece of paper could make a difference.
No warrior in the world could enjoy and fight two opponents at the same time.
Especially when their swords at their limits became sharper, it meant that Phaelito himself was risking his life.
The realm that Jin and Dante have reached, even if it can be called 'creation', cannot be ignored.

"Or is your mind so clouded with anger that you can't even realize this? Whether it's due to brainwashing, you definitely are different from the creators we've met so far. They would never let their guard down or be shaken for even a moment when facing us!"
Zuzuzuz-!
Again, magical energy was forming a curse. It was the curse of another demon called Tsuzaki, along with the mockery of Bisaro who had aged the two.
Jin and Dante perfectly avoided Bizaro's ridicule, but the same part was exposed to Tsujak's curse as before.
Tsujak was known as the most powerful demon before Zito, and the demons of the demon world called him the plague god.
Bubble, bubble...!

Their flesh was boiling in an instant from Tsujak's curse. Literally, the flesh was melting away in an instant and bubbling like lava. Blisters swelled up to the size of a fist and popped, and they had no choice but to clench their teeth each time.
The plague, like aging, didn't just affect the part it directly touched. It was trying to corrode the entire body as if water was seeping in.
Of course, their strong bodies did not easily allow the plague to rise. The aura was exploding like crazy inside their bodies, blocking the corrosion of the plague.
But that only meant their stamina would fall faster, and the plague was about to engulf their entire bodies.

"Blurt out such things after you've threatened me once, Sword Emperor of Inse. Yes, I admit that you guys are strong enough. But that's it. Do you know how many beings as strong as, or stronger than you, I've broken during my long life? Even they feared me and dared not stretch their hands towards Sakiel."
The evil in Phaelito's eyes seemed to materialize and overwhelm them at any moment.
In fact, Jin and Dante were seeing that illusion. A huge, dark shadow of malice was looking down on them.
"You took too much from me......"
Phaelito said with his eyes closed.
In the meantime, Jin briefly evaluated what he could do right now.
First of all, he reduced the magic power consumed by the Flame Ascension. He didn't completely cancel the Flame Ascension, but left only the minimum maintenance power.
And then, he put a frost seal he learned from Valeria on Dante's right ankle, which was aging and decaying.
When the transparent chill wrapped around Dante's ankle, the progress of the plague visibly slowed down. It almost seemed to have stopped.
"With this, you should be able to move more naturally than before. If luck is on our side, we may be able to get treatment after we kill that bastard."
Crack!
Then Jin cut off his own left arm with Bradamante. Thump, his left arm, which had turned black as charcoal, fell to the ground and shattered.
"Jin!?"
"I'm not in a condition to maintain two seals. It's better for me to lose an arm than for you to lose a leg. If you lose a leg, there's really no answer."
The plague that had been sticking to the fallen left arm could no longer penetrate Jin's body. After freezing the wound, Jin held the sword in one hand.
His firm eyes were shining. Dante swallowed the words that were welling up in his throat and gathered his strength. Because he couldn't fight an enemy being swayed by emotions.
"You look better than before, Jin Runcandel."
"Do I?"
"Well, it's a decent alternative, I suppose. In the end, you'll probably lose all your limbs that way."

"If losing an arm makes me weak, then I cannot be called the Twin King, and if I can't overcome a desperate crisis, then I am not worthy of being the head of the Runcandel. Furthermore, if I'm afraid of losing a leg in battle, I can't be called the Sword Emperor."
Jin smiled at Phaelito.
"So this is indeed a better look, Phaelito Belgasium. You've got it spot on."
The rapidly decaying flames were quietly smoldering.
Phaelito actually felt that Jin and Dante had become even stronger.
'...The crisis is drawing out something buried in their bodies and souls.'
It wasn't surprising. Monsters cornered usually shed their skin again. He had experienced it many times when facing formidable foes in the past.
And Phaelito had never lost in such situations. He had never let go of an advantage he had gained, and he had never been careless enough to be defeated.
'I will do the same this time, Sakiel.'
Phaelito extended Baschkara forward. At the same time, the infernal sword unfolded, and the two rushed at him before their senses blurred.
The sword energy of Bradamante and Rashid spread out diagonally. The sword energy aimed for Phaelito's heart, and he grabbed the sword energy with his bare hand, letting out a battle cry.
And with the sword energy in his hand, he scattered it in all directions, twisting the paths of the two. Then, he stabbed his sword towards Dante's neck.
Dante would parry it.
Phaelito expected that. Because he had aimed squarely, it would be impossible to dodge. As expected, Dante couldn't avoid Phaelito's stab.
However, Dante did not just parry Baschkara. At the moment when Rashid and Baschkara collided, he dropped his sword and caught Baschkara with his palm as if clapping.
Phaelito, unfazed, tried to cut Dante in half, but Jin's sword was too close.
In the end, Phaelito couldn't cut Dante. As soon as he gave up on Dante, Dante released Baschkara and exploded the dragon sword armor.
A sharp piece of aura debris from the dragon sword armor grazed Phaelito's face. Phaelito turned around and blocked Jin's strike with a downward slash of his sword.
Jin, with his posture almost as low as his face hitting the ground, was grinning.
"I am grateful to you for one thing, Phaelito. Thanks to you, I feel the sensation of growing stronger, something I haven't felt in a long time..."
